purpose: 原自动重字只核同一原报告；2021Q1原印刷日与元生成日分开，不修改原PDF。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,pdfplumber
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_enterprise_working_capital_source_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
dest=OUT/'rendered_originals';dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True);rows=[]
for q,ids in [('2020Q4',[0,1,3,4,5]),('2021Q1',[0])]:
 p=OUT/'sources'/(q+'.pdf');before=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 with pdfplumber.open(p) as doc:
  for i in ids:
   target=dest/f'{q}_原PDF第{i+1}页.png';assert not target.exists()
   doc.pages[i].to_image(resolution=140).save(target)
   rows.append({'quarter':q,'original_pdf':str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),'original_pdf_sha256':before,'pdf_page_1based':i+1,'render':str(target.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),'render_sha256':hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
 assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==before
record={'completed_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'originals_edited':False,'renders':rows,'new_network':0,'new_fits':0}
rp=OUT/'同一原PDF页渲染回执.json';assert not rp.exists();rp.write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'同一原页已渲染':len(rows),'源PDF保持':True,'网络及金融':0},ensure_ascii=False))
